test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and K are sitting around a circle facing the centre. A is third to the left of H, who is fourth to the left of G. C is fourth to the right of D, who is second to the right of A. E is third to the left of G. B is fourth to the right of K. In which of the following combinations are the three persons sitting together?
solution: Nine person: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and K are sitting around a circle facing the centre 1) A is third to the left of H, who is fourth to the left of G. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c186f57f1a2487bdd395c6be2e9db055eb2ce9746fdd1f0958cfd7d2458d3c0.png] 2) C is fourth to the right of D, who is second to the right of A.
